scope: DEI-T44 successor resumes durable context in a compatible shared checkout
evidence: Disposable real Git checkout has a committed baseline and durable uncommitted file change. Native progress records its source/base, affected Target, work summary and remaining work.
A later short context-only note does not erase prior work. Writer SQL session closes; successor uses fresh session/store and real GetDeliveryEvidenceUseCase with only evidence.read permission.
One resume response supplies the latest note, earlier durable checkpoint, Target path/source, declared base, remaining work, obligations and verification plan. Whole-Spec rollup is forbidden.

The external successor resolves the file path from the returned Target, verifies actual shared checkout HEAD against declared baseline and reads the persisted work. No full-history/detail call is required.

Prior implementation becomes stale after material progress, but retains original author and execution submitter. Recovery/access remain unverified/unknown, receipt ownership does not transfer, read-only successor gains no progress-write authority.

attempts.reason: Test expected detail-only nested progress; resume manifest exposes remaining/target_ids/source_state directly. Corrected assertion to actual closed manifest contract, without fetching detail.

limits: Shared checkout/source mapping and read principal are controlled fixture inputs. Filesystem/Git access is performed by external actor test mechanics, never by Pulse domain code.
Tests a bounded compatible handoff, not arbitrary inaccessible or incompatible workspaces, all-history performance, installed transport authentication or UI rendering.
No product/frontend change. Prior frontend44 hash verified; not rerun or recounted. Main88 installed parity and closure remain applicable with eight zero budgets.
